  "tools": [
    {"name": "awesome-gamedev-agent-skills", "url": "https://github.com/gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skills"},
    {"name": "gittrend.io", "url": "gittrend.io"}
  ],
  "on_screen_text": "GitHub - gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skil... | github.com/gamedev-skills/awesome-gamedev-agent-skil... | README | Contributing | Apache-2.0 license | awesome-gamedev-agent-skills | Game-dev skills for your AI coding agent. Build any game, in any engine. | 74 skills • 10 engines • one install | 74 game-dev skills for your AI coding agent — install once, and a router loads the right skill for whatever you're building. | GIVE YOUR AI | Agent Skills are small capability files an AI agent loads only when it needs them. This repo gives your agent 74 game-dev skills and a router that picks the right ones for you. You describe what you're building; the agent loads the matching engine and task skills before it writes code. | Cross-engine. Godot, Unity, Unreal, Phaser, PixiJS, three.js, Bevy, pygame, LOVE, Roblox. | You don't pick a [task and loads only] what it fits. | Art direction, not one-off generations. The asset workflow locks a visual target, builds families, normalizes outputs deterministically, and checks them inside the game. | Built to trust. Every skill is written from primary docs, version-pinned to a stated engine release, and checked by a validator. Current baselines and upgrade policy live in version support. | Contents | Quick start | What you can ask | gittrend.io",
  "key_claims": [
    "The pack gives an AI coding agent 74 game-dev skills with one install",
    "A router automatically picks the right skill for your engine (Godot, Unity, Unreal, or the web) and task",
    "It supports cross-engine development including Godot, Unity, Unreal, Phaser, PixiJS, three.js, Bevy, pygame, LOVE, and Roblox",
    "Includes a workflow that keeps game art looking consistent/cohesive",
    "Each skill is derived from official engine documentation so the agent doesn't guess at details",
    "Every skill is version-pinned to a stated engine release and checked by a validator",
    "It's free and open-source",
    "Can be installed with one command in the agent you already use"
  ],
  "info_channel": "spoken"
}
